packageRules.description: Open the weekly lock file refresh before majors, so a backlog of majors under the 3-PR cap never starves it

tailwindcss and @tailwindcss/postcss get their own group, kept out of group:allNonMajor: they need a visual check, and an artifact failure on their native optional packages (EALLOWREMOTE on @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi, PR #91) must not leave the whole non-major group without a lockfile
